heroText: A space by the sea to move, breathe and take a moment for yourself. Discover Mandala Yoga Santa Pola.
aboutTitle: A place to breathe and reconnect
aboutText: Mandala Yoga Santa Pola is a yoga centre by the coast in Santa Pola. Practice invites you to listen to your body and find a pause in your routine.
classesIntro: Hatha Yoga and other movement practices featured in the centre’s posts. Confirm current groups before attending.
class1Text: Postures, breathing and mindful movement at a measured pace.
class2Text: A more active practice shown in Mandala Yoga’s posts. Ask about upcoming sessions and levels.
class3Text: Gentle movements and body awareness. Check the current timetable directly with the centre.
scheduleText: This timetable comes from an image shared by the centre and may have changed. Ask about current sessions and availability.
communityTitle: A space open to the sea
communityText: Images shared by Mandala Yoga show practice on the beach and in the studio. Ask about upcoming activities.
a1: The shared timetable mentions beginners and advanced participants. Ask which group suits you.
a2: Please ask the centre which equipment you need for your class.
q3: How do I ask about a place?
a3: Call +34 622 87 26 97 to check the current timetable and availability.
a4: The centre is at Av. Dama de Elche, 9, 03130 Santa Pola, Alicante.
contactText: Ask about current classes and times, or visit the centre at the address shown.

aboutExtra: Hatha Yoga brings attention to postures and breathing, encouraging a steady practice. Chi Kung uses slow, continuous movements focused on coordination and balance. The centre has also mentioned dynamic yoga in its posts; ask which groups are currently available.
